stem.text: The ammonium ion is formed by the following reaction.
Which statement about the species involved in this reaction is correct?

A.text: The ammonia molecule contains a dative covalent bond.

B.text: The ammonium ion is a Brønsted-Lowry base as it has accepted a proton.

C.text: The H–N–H bond angle changes from $107^{\circ}$ in ammonia to $90^{\circ}$ in the ammonium ion.

D.text: The number of electrons surrounding each nitrogen atom does not change.
